# Supine mixer replacement handoff

This packet repairs the first two runtime cards in the 2026-09-14 humanoid-motion graph. The old C0 mixed two responsibilities: register-time mixer eligibility in `xr-asset-loading`, and during-playback posture/support stability owned by `xr-humanoid-animation`. Its write root could not honestly prove both. The old C0 is blocked and must remain undispatched. The old C2 is superseded when the replacement C2 is created.

## Current code boundary

`packages/openclinxr/xr-asset-loading/src/humanoid-animation.ts` currently withholds every mixer from a supine actor. It already knows the actor posture, selected touch-response clip names, and translated bone names. It also already suppresses all auto-play for a supine actor. Replacement C0 changes only this registration decision: a supine mixer may exist when at least one explicitly selected response clip has no measured bone-translation track. The mixer must create no actions at registration; touch playback remains downstream.

`packages/openclinxr/xr-humanoid-animation/src/animation-loop.ts` updates the mixer and then reapplies the supine posture and support hold. Replacement C2 therefore owns conversion/binding of the compiled clip, owned-bone policy, same-actor identity, and before/during/after support/world-transform proof. C0 must not claim any of those results.

## C0R execution contract

Start from the committed RED test `packages/openclinxr/xr-asset-loading/src/a-supine-patient-mixes-only-posture-safe-one-shots.test.ts`. The first clause is deliberately `it.fails`: changing only that marker to `it` fails on the baseline because the safe supine actor has no mixer. Before product edits, preserve that failure output or a RED-only commit. Then implement the smallest policy in `humanoid-animation.ts` and flip both `it.fails` clauses to ordinary `it` only when they pass; the `live:` gate permits no remaining expected-failure marker.

Required behavior:

- A supine actor receives a mixer only when at least one selected loaded response clip has no measured `.position` translation on any bone.
- Registration creates no action for the response, locomotion, or standing idle clip.
- Any selected loaded response with a measured `.position` translation on any bone leaves the supine actor mixer-free.
- Supine deck planting still runs exactly once.
- Standing and seated behavior remain unchanged.
- Product logic contains no actor-id exception and adds no public export.

Stop if the rule cannot be derived from posture, selected response identity, and track metadata. Record the failed treatment instead of deleting the supine guard broadly.

## C2R execution contract

C2R waits for C0R and the existing blocked C1 (`tsk_8d3e55209b513362`). It converts the compiled sidecar tracks, binds them to the already loaded patient, and owns the animation-loop/posture composition proof. It must establish an explicit upper-body owned-bone contract that the per-frame supine posture pass honors while the stretcher support and actor world transform remain fixed. It must not load or parent the sidecar GLB as a second actor.

## Allocation and renewal

Claude is the delegation manager. Do not call global `tasks.next`. After the owner Plants C0R, re-read it and verify ready, unassigned, dependency-free, and rooted only in `packages/openclinxr/xr-asset-loading/src`. Claim that exact task ID, read back its `assigneeAgentId`, then mint the session. Dispatch in an isolated worktree (`worktree: true`) with `slice` equal to the raw `tsk_…` task ID, `sessionId` equal to the minted session, and `bothyAgentId` equal to that exact assignee. After spawn, bind `{ grokSessionId, grokSubagentId, taskId, machineName }` to that same task with `sessions.bind`, then register the returned worktree path and branch with `worktrees.register` on the same machine. Verify the same claim survives a two-minute renewal interval. Heartbeat with only task/session is presence and does not renew the exact claimant.

C2R is a design draft only. Do not create it until a committed bind/pose RED exists and C1 is Landed. The old C0 and old C2 must never be dispatched.

## Reservations at preparation

At 2026-09-15 06:05 EDT, Claude reported zero workers in flight and released `tools/openclinxr/openclaw`, `tools/openclinxr/asset-pipeline/trellis`, and `docs/openclinxr`. The unrelated ready viseme-label card `tsk_68499a16e3ea6c09` owns docs+trellis if claimed; this packet does not assign that card. Shared main's owner-memory pulse remains unrelated and must not be staged.

## Verification boundary

C0R proves register-time eligibility and zero auto-play only. C2R/C3 prove actual touch playback, bone motion, support stability, actor identity, and visible evidence. No card claims clinical validity or Quest readiness.
